sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.

sources.title: qingpingwan/Qwen2.5-7B-Lora-Law · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-LoRA-Law This repository contains trained weights for a fine-tuned version of the Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model, specialized for answering legal questions in Chinese. The model is fine-tuned using LoRA on the DISC-Law-SFT dataset.

sources.title: GitHub - iamyuviii/qwen3-legal-lora
sources.snippet: Model Card for qwen3-legal-lora This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen3-.6B. It has been trained using TRL.

sources.title: Qwen Legal Domain Fine-tuning with LoRA - GitHub
sources.snippet: A lightweight domain-adapted language model for legal document analysis and classification in traditional Chinese, fine-tuned using LoRA and JSONL-format legal datasets. - jeremy-217/law-llm
